comparison.objective: Screen media from finished washers, versus diverting reject cartons from a moving line while preserving good cartons.
comparison.physical_skill: Controlled pouring and bimanual screen agitation versus lateral pushing of selected cartons during conveyor motion.
comparison.success_condition: Recovered media mass, washer preservation and safe screen release versus rejects on the reject table and good cartons undisturbed.
comparison.reason: Both involve selective handling, but the tested mechanics—granular screening versus conveyor diversion—are meaningfully different.
